name: Yext Search
description: Integrates Yext hosted search into Drupal via blocks and a settings form.
project_description:
This module provide an integration of yext search .

 The Yext Search Experience Cloud is a Software as a Service (SaaS) product suite that puts businesses in control of their facts online. By providing official answers on their own websites — then across search engines, maps, apps, voice assistants and chatbots — Yext helps businesses answer those questions everywhere consumers search.

 REQUIREMENTS

------------

 Need to create an account on yext.com .

 INSTALLATION

------------

 * Install the Yext Search module as you would normally install a

 contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information.

 CONFIGURATION

------------

After successfully installing the module yext search,

 1. Navigate admin/config/yext/settings and add yext search settings.

2. You can place the 'Yext Search Bar' and 'Yext Search Result' blocks on the region.

 admin -> structure -> block -> Place 'Yext Search Bar' and 'Yext Search Result' on region.
